title: Residential Electricity Supply Renewal Rate: Tenure Reduction Schedule
content:
Renewals desk schedule, Residential Electricity Supply. A customer who renews receives a tenure reduction on the renewal rate according to how long the agreement has been in Beacon Ridge supply.

| Whole months from the agreement's service start date to the election date | Tenure reduction (cents per kWh) |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 0.40 (long-tenure reduction) |
| 18 to 35 | 0.25 (mid-tenure reduction) |
| fewer than 18 | none |

**Rule.** When the agreement's service start date is 36 or more whole months before the election date the long-tenure reduction applies, when it is 18 to 35 whole months before the mid-tenure reduction applies, and when it is fewer than 18 whole months before no tenure reduction applies.

**Counting.** The service start date is the switch meter read date on which supply began, as recorded on the agreement; renewals and plan changes do not reset it. A month is whole once the same day of the month is reached.

**Boundaries (hypothetical service start 2023-04-10).**

- Election on 2026-04-10: 36 whole months, 0.40 cents.
- Election on 2026-04-09: 35 whole months, 0.25 cents.
- Election on 2024-10-10: 18 whole months, 0.25 cents; on 2024-10-09: 17 whole months, none.
